name: ateam-train-me-on-ai-gcc
displayName: Train Me on AI for GCC by ATeam
description: A personal AI coach for founders, business owners and non-technical teams in the GCC. It trains you on your own business and real tasks, in Arabic or English: how to ask, check the answer, work with numbers, research, build routines and delegate, with a plan and log of what you learnt and the time it saves. It helps you solve everyday GCC business problems with AI, from WhatsApp enquiries and Arabic-English documents to tenders and compliance paperwork, checks AI vendors' proposals before you sign, and helps you keep sensitive data out of AI tools.
